page: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-48-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine based on the ARMv8 64-bit architecture. It features 48 dedicated physical cores powered by ARM Neoverse-V2 processors clocked at 3.0 GHz, operating with one thread per core. Memory capacity is allocated at 192 GB of RAM, preserving a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per core. The processor subsystem includes 64 KB of L1 data cache, 2 MB of L2 cache, and an 80 MB shared L3 cache, alongside integrated hardware AES cryptographic capabilities. Storage is bundled directly via 4,020 GB of local NVMe SSDs across 10 devices, while no hardware accelerators or GPUs are included.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong multi-threaded compute and memory subsystem performance. The instance achieved a Geekbench multi-core score of 24,288.0 and a Clang software compilation score of 71,188.0, both placing in the top 10% tier. Stress-ng multi-core testing reached 87,014.41 points, reflecting efficient 48-core parallelization despite moderate single-core benchmark ratings. Memory performance is equally capable, with PassMark memory scoring in the top 10% at 3,183.47 points, supported by uncached read bandwidth of 286.75 GB/sec and uncached write bandwidth of 143.04 GB/sec. Application testing shows top-tier outcomes in static web serving at 97.21 GB/sec, database operations scoring 48,182.95, and Redis SET throughput exceeding 98 million operations per second.

The primary architectural tradeoff lies in the contrast between moderate single-threaded instruction throughput and high multi-core scalability coupled with fast local I/O. For operations requiring extensive x86 instruction sets such as AVX-512 or AMX, compatibility adjustments are necessary due to the ARM architecture. Given its dedicated core layout and dense local NVMe storage, this server offers robust resource efficiency for parallelized, I/O-intensive workloads including relational databases, high-throughput caching tiers, software build systems, and containerized web services.
description: Google Cloud Platform c4a-standard-48-lssd is an ARM-based general-purpose instance featuring 48 dedicated ARM Neoverse-V2 cores operating at 3.0 GHz, 192 GB of system memory, and 4,020 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage. Utilizing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM allocation, it delivers top-tier parallel processing and memory throughput, as evidenced by Geekbench multi-core scores in the upper decile and uncached read bandwidth exceeding 286 GB/sec. Single-core performance registers in the middle tier, making the hardware best aligned with highly concurrent, multithreaded tasks rather than single-threaded processing. The substantial bundled NVMe capacity enables fast local I/O, reflected in strong Redis, database, and static web serving benchmarks. Without GPUs or x86 instruction extensions, the instance is optimized for multi-threaded compilation pipelines, high-density web serving, Redis caching tiers, and localized database workloads.
